This repository is mergeCraft — a BYOK AI PR-review GitHub Action plus a Python
CLI. Python **3.11+**, uv, recurring contributor commands via Make (`make lint`,
`make test`, `make ci`). Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for setup steps when
asked to install mergeCraft into another repo and for development rules when
working in this tree. Never weaken trust-tier or fail-closed security behaviour;
never commit secrets or credentials.
